note: Set A captures the key behavioral and design facts that Set B omits entirely: the threaded base connection, added strain lowering the transition temperature, the large hysteresis period slowing louver closure, and all four Harvest Shade Screens design parameters. Set B instead repeats trivial diagram labels and duplicate rod/louver counts, and several of its quotes are truncated or garbled (e.g. 'has a tran between 15C and 30C') or carry conditions not supported by the quoted text (idler pulley 'located at the top', rods conditioned on 'final assembly'). Set A's only real defects are two connection claims (idler pulley–Kevlar string, Kevlar string–tension spring) whose quotes are bare labels and do not support the stated connection. Overall A is more complete and more faithful.
